description: Reservatórios is a dataset listed in Brazilian national water resources information system metadata catalogue (SNIRH), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Agência Nacional de Águas e Saneamento Básico (ANA, SNIRH). São apresentados dados do percentual do volume armazenado dos reservatórios monitorados pela ANA no início e final de 2015. O monitoramento da situação dos reservatórios é realizado pela ANA em articulação com os estados e órgãos responsáveis pela operação dos mesmos (ONS, DNOCS, COGERH, AESA, APAC, CERB, INEMA, CODEVASF, COMPESA, SEMARH - RN). Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are conjuntura, recursos hídricos, reservatórios, capacidade, volume armazenado. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-snirh-portal.
